title: Admin Users

roleDescriptions.super_admin: Full unrestricted access to all features and settings.
roleDescriptions.admin: Can manage all content and users, but cannot modify system settings.
roleDescriptions.moderator: Can review and moderate content (verifications, health certs, feedback).
roleDescriptions.viewer: Read-only access to dashboards and reports.

permissionsHelp: Configure page-level access and actions for this admin.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this admin? This action cannot be undone.
cannotDeleteSuper: Super Admin accounts cannot be deleted.
